name: smwmusic-marvel-vs-capcom-clash-of-super-heroes-fighting-streets-ryu-s-theme-remix
title: Marvel vs. CAPCOM: Clash of Super Heroes - Fighting Streets ~ Ryu's Theme (Remix)
description:
𝗗𝗼𝗻'𝘁 𝗳𝗶𝗴𝗵𝘁 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝘃𝗶𝗰𝘁𝗼𝗿𝘆--𝗳𝗶𝗴𝗵𝘁 𝘁𝗼 𝗶𝗺𝗽𝗿𝗼𝘃𝗲 𝘆𝗼𝘂𝗿𝘀𝗲𝗹𝗳. 𝗩𝗶𝗰𝘁𝗼𝗿𝘆 𝘄𝗶𝗹𝗹 𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗲.

Back with the Street Fighter remixes, and so I did Ryu's Theme from Marvel vs. CAPCOM: Clash of Super Heroes, which, funny enough, is actually an "extended" arrangement of the Street Fighter II main theme instead of the usual Suzaku Castle arrangement. It's one of my favorite themes in the Street Fighter series, and it kicks ass!!

Great fit for [final] boss fights, tense sections, chase sequences, final areas, title screens, and .

Important:
- "Bonus End," & Thunder SFX are disabled.

There are also 2 customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. D Minor (Original Pitch, turned on default)
2. C Minor (Super Street Fighter II Turbo Pitch)
